title: Colo. Rev. Stat. § 13-80-102 — Limitations on actions for torts
content:
Colo. Rev. Stat. § 13-80-102

(1)(a) A person shall commence an action for any of the following within two years after the cause of action accrues:

(I) Tort actions, including actions for the recovery of any fine, penalty, or forfeiture, or for bodily injury or property damage arising out of the use or operation of a motor vehicle.

title: Colo. Rev. Stat. § 4-2-725 — Statute of limitations in contracts for sale
content:
Colo. Rev. Stat. § 4-2-725

(1) An action for breach of any contract for sale must be commenced within four years after the cause of action has accrued. By the original agreement the parties may reduce the period of limitation to not less than one year but may not extend it.

title: Lester v. Sayles, 850 P.2d 892 (Colo. 1993)
content:
Lester v. Sayles, 850 P.2d 892 (Colo. 1993).

[Excerpt — holding summary.]

The Supreme Court of Colorado held that comparative negligence applies in tort actions and a plaintiff's recovery is diminished in proportion to the plaintiff's percentage of fault.

opinionParts.content: Comparative negligence applies; a plaintiff's recovery is diminished in proportion to the plaintiff's percentage of fault.
